boundary_condition.note: The theorem statements summarize procedural behavior exercised by CASE_014 through CASE_017 and do not assert universal properties beyond the procedural universe defined by the constitution and schema.

core_family_theorem.note: CASE_FAMILY_V3 demonstrates procedural states in which individually valid provenance branches, temporal histories, policy lineages, and agent chains cannot be composed into a coherent global state. No local component is retroactively invalidated merely because composition fails.

family_level_mandate.note: When valid components collide under composition, the protocol preserves the collision as a first-class replayable state and does not silently rewrite otherwise valid component histories solely to manufacture coherence.

membrane_guarantees.note: Detection of a composition-level collision does not retroactively invalidate locally valid branches.
Recording a conflict as replayable does not imply that the protocol has resolved the underlying incompatibility.
Failure of a combined state does not imply failure of every component participating in that composition.
A global HOLD may coexist with locally valid component states.
Successful procedural execution of a collision case does not establish substantive truth outside the protocol.
The theorem layer describes replay behavior inside CASE_FAMILY_V3 and grants no epistemic, legal, policy, or decision authority.

theorems.note: Two individually valid provenance structures may remain valid while their attempted composition fails coherence.
Two temporal branches may each remain valid in isolation while their merged causal timeline fails. Temporal collision applies to the merge, not retroactively to either branch.

A valid policy lineage and a valid temporal lineage may fail coherence when policy applicability is recursively evaluated against historical events. Neither lineage is invalidated solely by the combined applicability collision.
Distinct root-qualified agent chains may each remain locally valid while shared unqualified identifiers fail to resolve into one coherent global agent state.
